deep_dive_report.report_title: Deep Dive OON Analysis - MCM004 Medicare GRS - R6 Period

detail_statements: Out of 91,658 total claims, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 3.71% and PMPM ratio decreased by 45.25% for R6 period.
In CA, out of 91,658 total claims (for R6), 58,128 (63.42%) were NPAR, resulting in $43,073,012.17 in OON payments.

In CA, out of 159 total NPAR claims for Provider STANFORD HOSPITAL under the PPO Local product, 32.47% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In CA, no IDR-flagged claims were identified during the R6 period.
Out of 81,714 total claims, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 74.43% and PMPM ratio increased by 31.92% for R6 period.
In GA, out of 81,714 total claims (for R6), 51,130 (62.57%) were NPAR, resulting in $44,329,065.50 in OON payments.

In GA, out of 37 total NPAR claims for Provider PHOEBE PUTNEY MEMORIAL HOSPITAL under the PPO Local product, 91.89% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In GA, no IDR-flagged claims were identified during the R6 period.
Out of 27,875 total claims, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 25.42% and PMPM ratio decreased by 2.41% for R6 period.
In OH, out of 27,875 total claims (for R6), 19,200 (68.88%) were NPAR, resulting in $8,231,311.26 in OON payments.

In OH, out of 33 total NPAR claims for Provider ESSENTIA HEALTH - VIRGINIA under the PPO Local product, 17.57% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In OH, no IDR-flagged claims were identified during the R6 period.

STANFORD HOSPITAL shows a recurring PAR/OON reimbursement overlap for the same provider and facility service types, indicating inconsistent network assignment and potential provider configuration gaps.

Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours with MCC and Chemotherapy without Acute Leukemia as Secondary Diagnosis with CC account for approximately 80% of total OON reimbursements for STANFORD HOSPITAL.

HOMETOWN HEALTHCARE shows a recurring PAR/OON reimbursement overlap for similar member populations and professional service types, indicating inconsistent network assignment and potential provider configuration gaps.
All NPAR claims for HOMETOWN HEALTHCARE are concentrated in unmapped DRG categories.
No IDR-flagged claims were identified for any provider during the R6 period for Medicare GRS.

detail_statements: During the same R6 period, NPAR claim volume and associated paid amounts increased for TANNER MEDICAL CENTER CARROLLTON, indicating higher NPAR utilization and an elevated PMPM impact (NPAR spend per member month) relative to the baseline.
